tools.note: Handlers run in this process because A3P_ISOLATION=inprocess was set. The recommended default, when that variable is unset, is container if Docker can run the sandbox image, then bubblewrap, then a subprocess.

model.detail: No network call. The model is a scripted stand-in.

probe.note: Scoring and the ledger run in the probe process. They are not inside the tool sandbox.

statement: assessed under A3P Method v1.0, level A3P-L1
limits: A scripted adapter repeats this score. A live model can still differ at temperature 0. The bundle lets a third party rerun the procedure. It does not make the agent safe.
